method.public_headline: POB novelty × square-root(reference consensus); documented risk is excluded

public_domain_references.brenton: Woe to them that dwell on the border of the sea, neighbours of the Cretans! the word of the Lord is against you, O Chanaan, land of the Philistines, and I will destroy you out of [your] dwelling-place.

pob.text: And the seacoast shall become pastures, with wells for shepherds and enclosures for flocks.

spob.text: The seacoast will become pastureland, with wells for shepherds and pens for their flocks.

public_domain_references.bsb: So the seacoast will become a land of pastures, with wells for shepherds and folds for sheep.
public_domain_references.web: The sea coast will be pastures, with cottages for shepherds and folds for flocks.
public_domain_references.asv: And the sea-coast shall be pastures, with cottages for shepherds and folds for flocks.
public_domain_references.kjv: And the sea coast shall be dwellings [and] cottages for shepherds, and folds for flocks.
public_domain_references.brenton: And Crete shall be a pasture of flocks, and a fold of sheep.

pob.text: And the coastland shall belong to the remnant of the house of Judah; on it they shall pasture. In the houses of Ashkelon they shall lie down at evening, for Yahweh their God will attend to them and restore their fortunes.

spob.text: The coastland will belong to the remnant of Judah. They will use it as pasture. In the evening they will lie down in the houses of Ashkelon, because Yahweh their God will care for them[a] and restore their fortunes.[b]

public_domain_references.bsb: The coast will belong to the remnant of the house of Judah; there they will find pasture. They will lie down in the evening among the houses of Ashkelon, for the LORD their God will attend to them and restore their captives.
public_domain_references.web: The coast will be for the remnant of the house of Judah. They will find pasture. In the houses of Ashkelon, they will lie down in the evening, for Yahweh, their God, will visit them and restore them.
public_domain_references.asv: And the coast shall be for the remnant of the house of Judah; they shall feed [their flocks] thereupon; in the houses of Ashkelon shall they lie down in the evening; for Jehovah their God will visit them, and bring back their captivity.
public_domain_references.kjv: And the coast shall be for the remnant of the house of Judah; they shall feed thereupon: in the houses of Ashkelon shall they lie down in the evening: for the LORD their God shall visit them, and turn away their captivity.
public_domain_references.brenton: And the sea coast shall be for the remnant of the house of Juda; they shall pasture upon them in the houses of Ascalon; they shall rest in the evening because of the children of Juda; for the Lord their God has visited them, and he will turn away their captivity.

pob.text: I have heard the reproach of Moab and the insults of the sons of Ammon[b][a], with which they reproached my people and magnified themselves against their border.

spob.text: I have heard Moab’s scorn and the Ammonites’ insults. They used these words to shame my people and boasted against their border.

public_domain_references.bsb: “I have heard the reproach of Moab and the insults of the Ammonites, who have taunted My people and threatened their borders.
public_domain_references.web: I have heard the reproach of Moab and the insults of the children of Ammon, with which they have reproached my people and magnified themselves against their border.
public_domain_references.asv: I have heard the reproach of Moab, and the revilings of the children of Ammon, wherewith they have reproached my people, and magnified themselves against their border.
public_domain_references.kjv: ¶ I have heard the reproach of Moab, and the revilings of the children of Ammon, whereby they have reproached my people, and magnified [themselves] against their border.
public_domain_references.brenton: I have heard the revilings of Moab, and the insults of the children of Ammon, wherewith they have reviled my people, and magnified themselves against my coasts.

pob.text: Therefore[a], as I live, declares Yahweh of hosts, the God of Israel, Moab will surely become like Sodom, and the sons of Ammon like Gomorrah—a place overgrown with weeds, a salt pit, and a perpetual desolation. The remnant of my people will plunder them[b], and the remainder of my nation will inherit them.

spob.text: Therefore, Yahweh of hosts, the God of Israel, declares: “As surely as I live, Moab will become like Sodom, and the Ammonites like Gomorrah. Their land will be overgrown with weeds,[a] become a salt pit, and remain desolate forever. The remnant of my people will plunder them, and those who remain of my nation will inherit them.”

public_domain_references.bsb: Therefore, as surely as I live,” declares the LORD of Hosts, the God of Israel, “surely Moab will be like Sodom and the Ammonites like Gomorrah— a place of weeds and salt pits, a perpetual wasteland. The remnant of My people will plunder them; the remainder of My nation will dispossess them.”
public_domain_references.web: Therefore, as I live, says Yahweh of Armies, the God of Israel, surely Moab will be as Sodom, and the children of Ammon as Gomorrah, a possession of nettles and salt pits, and a perpetual desolation. The remnant of my people will plunder them, and the survivors of my nation will inherit them.
public_domain_references.asv: Therefore as I live, saith Jehovah of hosts, the God of Israel, Surely Moab shall be as Sodom, and the children of Ammon as Gomorrah, a possession of nettles, and saltpits, and a perpetual desolation: the residue of my people shall make a prey of them, and the remnant of my nation shall inherit them.
public_domain_references.kjv: Therefore [as] I live, saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel, Surely Moab shall be as Sodom, and the children of Ammon as Gomorrah, [even] the breeding of nettles, and saltpits, and a perpetual desolation: the residue of my people shall spoil them, and the remnant of my people shall possess them.
public_domain_references.brenton: Therefore, [as] I live, saith the Lord of hosts, the God of Israel, Moab shall be as Sodoma, and the children of Ammon as Gomorrha; and Damascus [shall be] left as a heap of the threshing-floor, and desolate for ever: and the remnant of my people shall plunder them, and the remnant of my nation shall inherit them.

pob.text: This will be their lot in return for their pride[a], because they taunted and magnified themselves against the people of Yahweh of Armies.

spob.text: This is what they will receive for their pride, because they mocked the people of Yahweh of Armies[a] and made themselves great over them.

public_domain_references.bsb: This they shall have in return for their pride, for taunting and mocking the people of the LORD of Hosts.
public_domain_references.web: This they will have for their pride, because they have reproached and magnified themselves against the people of Yahweh of Armies.
public_domain_references.asv: This shall they have for their pride, because they have reproached and magnified themselves against the people of Jehovah of hosts.
public_domain_references.kjv: This shall they have for their pride, because they have reproached and magnified [themselves] against the people of the LORD of hosts.
public_domain_references.brenton: This is their punishment in return for their haughtiness, because they have reproached and magnified themselves against the Lord Almighty.

pob.text: Yahweh will be fearsome against them[a], for he will make all the gods of the earth waste away; and they will bow down to him, each from his own place[b], all the coastlands of the nations.

spob.text: Yahweh will be terrifying to them, because he will make all the gods of the earth waste away.[a] People from all the distant coastlands of the nations will bow down to him, each from their own place.[b]

public_domain_references.bsb: The LORD will be terrifying to them when He starves all the gods of the earth. Then the nations of every shore will bow in worship to Him, each in its own place.
public_domain_references.web: Yahweh will be awesome to them, for he will famish all the gods of the land. Men will worship him, everyone from his place, even all the shores of the nations.
public_domain_references.asv: Jehovah will be terrible unto them; for he will famish all the gods of the earth; and men shall worship him, every one from his place, even all the isles of the nations.
public_domain_references.kjv: The LORD [will be] terrible unto them: for he will famish all the gods of the earth; and [men] shall worship him, every one from his place, [even] all the isles of the heathen.
public_domain_references.brenton: The Lord shall appear against them, and shall utterly destroy all the gods of the nations of the earth; and they shall worship him every one from his place, [even] all the islands of the nations.

pob.text: You Cushites also will be slain by my sword[a][b].

spob.text: You people of Cush[a] will also be killed by my sword.[b]

public_domain_references.bsb: “You too, O Cushites, will be slain by My sword.”
public_domain_references.web: You Cushites also, you will be killed by my sword.
public_domain_references.asv: Ye Ethiopians also, ye shall be slain by my sword.
public_domain_references.kjv: ¶ Ye Ethiopians also, ye [shall be] slain by my sword.
public_domain_references.brenton: Ye Ethiopians also are the slain of my sword.

pob.text: And he will stretch out his hand against the north and destroy Assyria[a], and he will make Nineveh a desolation, dry like the wilderness.

spob.text: He will stretch out his hand against the north and destroy Assyria. He will turn Nineveh into a dry wasteland, like the wilderness.[a]

public_domain_references.bsb: And He will stretch out His hand against the north and destroy Assyria; He will make Nineveh a desolation, as dry as a desert.
public_domain_references.web: He will stretch out his hand against the north, destroy Assyria, and will make Nineveh a desolation, as dry as the wilderness.
public_domain_references.asv: And he will stretch out his hand against the north, and destroy Assyria, and will make Nineveh a desolation, and dry like the wilderness.
public_domain_references.kjv: And he will stretch out his hand against the north, and destroy Assyria; and will make Nineveh a desolation, [and] dry like a wilderness.
public_domain_references.brenton: And he shall stretch forth his hand against the north and destroy the Assyrian, and make Nineve a dry wilderness, [even] as a desert.

pob.text: Herds will lie down in her midst[a], every beast of the nations; both the desert owl and the hedgehog will spend the night among her capitals. A voice will sing in the window; devastation will be on the threshold[c][b], for her cedarwork has been laid bare.

spob.text: Herds will lie down within her—every kind of wild animal. Desert owls[a] and hedgehogs[b] will spend the night on the tops of her columns. A voice will sing from a window. Ruin will be at the threshold, because her cedar paneling has been stripped bare.

public_domain_references.bsb: Herds will lie down in her midst, creatures of every kind. Both the desert owl and screech owl will roost atop her pillars. Their calls will sound from the window, but desolation will lie on the threshold, for He will expose the beams of cedar.
public_domain_references.web: Herds will lie down in the middle of her, all kinds of animals. Both the pelican and the porcupine will lodge in its capitals. Their calls will echo through the windows. Desolation will be in the thresholds, for he has laid bare the cedar beams.
public_domain_references.asv: And herds shall lie down in the midst of her, all the beasts of the nations: both the pelican and the porcupine shall lodge in the capitals thereof; [their] voice shall sing in the windows; desolation shall be in the thresholds: for he hath laid bare the cedar-work.
public_domain_references.kjv: And flocks shall lie down in the midst of her, all the beasts of the nations: both the cormorant and the bittern shall lodge in the upper lintels of it; [their] voice shall sing in the windows; desolation [shall be] in the thresholds: for he shall uncover the cedar work.
public_domain_references.brenton: And flocks, and all the wild beasts of the land, and chameleons shall feed in the midst thereof: and hedgehogs shall lodge in the ceilings thereof; and wild beasts shall cry in the breaches thereof, and ravens in her porches, whereas her loftiness was [as] a cedar.

pob.text: This is the exultant city that lived securely[a], that said in her heart, ‘I am, and there is none besides me.’ How she has become a desolation[b], a resting place for wild animals! Everyone who passes by her will hiss and wave his hand.

spob.text: This is the proud, celebrating city that lived in safety. She said to herself, “I am, and there is no one besides me.” How she has become a devastated ruin,[a] a place where wild animals lie down! Everyone who passes by will hiss[b] at her and wave a hand.

public_domain_references.bsb: This carefree city that dwells securely, that thinks to herself: “I am it, and there is none besides me,” what a ruin she has become, a resting place for beasts. Everyone who passes by her hisses and shakes his fist.
public_domain_references.web: This is the joyous city that lived carelessly, that said in her heart, “I am, and there is no one besides me.” How she has become a desolation, a place for animals to lie down in! Everyone who passes by her will hiss and shake their fists.
public_domain_references.asv: This is the joyous city that dwelt carelessly, that said in her heart, I am, and there is none besides me: how is she become a desolation, a place for beasts to lie down in! every one that passeth by her shall hiss, and wag his hand.
public_domain_references.kjv: This [is] the rejoicing city that dwelt carelessly, that said in her heart, I [am], and [there is] none beside me: how is she become a desolation, a place for beasts to lie down in! every one that passeth by her shall hiss, [and] wag his hand.
public_domain_references.brenton: This is the scornful city that dwells securely, that says in her heart, I am, and there is no longer any [to be] after me: how is she become desolate, a habitation of wild beasts! every one that passes through her shall hiss, and shake his hands.

pob.text: Woe to the rebellious and defiled city[b][a], the oppressing one!

spob.text: Woe to this city! It is rebellious and defiled,[a] and it oppresses others.[b]

public_domain_references.bsb: Woe to the city of oppressors, rebellious and defiled!
public_domain_references.web: Woe to her who is rebellious and polluted, the oppressing city!
public_domain_references.asv: Woe to her that is rebellious and polluted! to the oppressing city!
public_domain_references.kjv: Woe to her that is filthy and polluted, to the oppressing city!
public_domain_references.brenton: Alas the glorious and ransomed city.

pob.text: She did not obey the voice[a]; she did not accept correction. She did not trust in Yahweh[d][c][b]; she did not draw near to her God.

spob.text: She did not listen to the voice and obey it. She did not accept correction. She did not trust Yahweh or draw near to her God.[a]

public_domain_references.bsb: She heeded no voice; she accepted no correction. She does not trust in the LORD; she has not drawn near to her God.
public_domain_references.web: She didn’t obey the voice. She didn’t receive correction. She didn’t trust in Yahweh. She didn’t draw near to her God.
public_domain_references.asv: She obeyed not the voice; she received not correction; she trusted not in Jehovah; she drew not near to her God.
public_domain_references.kjv: She obeyed not the voice; she received not correction; she trusted not in the LORD; she drew not near to her God.
public_domain_references.brenton: The dove hearkened not to the voice; she received not correction; she trusted not in the Lord, and she drew not near to her God.

pob.text: Her officials within her are roaring lions[a]; her judges are evening wolves that leave nothing for the morning.

spob.text: Inside the city, her officials are roaring lions. Her judges are wolves at dusk; they devour everything, leaving nothing by morning.[a]

public_domain_references.bsb: Her princes are roaring lions; her judges are evening wolves, leaving nothing for the morning.
public_domain_references.web: Her princes within her are roaring lions. Her judges are evening wolves. They leave nothing until the next day.
public_domain_references.asv: Her princes in the midst of her are roaring lions; her judges are evening wolves; they leave nothing till the morrow.
public_domain_references.kjv: Her princes within her [are] roaring lions; her judges [are] evening wolves; they gnaw not the bones till the morrow.
public_domain_references.brenton: Her princes within her were as roaring lions, her judges as the wolves of Arabia; they remained not till the morrow.

pob.text: Her prophets are reckless[a], treacherous men; her priests have profaned the holy[b]; they have done violence to the law.

spob.text: Her prophets are reckless and treacherous men. Her priests treat what is holy[a] as if it were not holy. They violently abuse the law.[b]

public_domain_references.bsb: Her prophets are reckless, faithless men. Her priests profane the sanctuary; they do violence to the law.
public_domain_references.web: Her prophets are arrogant and treacherous people. Her priests have profaned the sanctuary. They have done violence to the law.
public_domain_references.asv: Her prophets are light and treacherous persons; her priests have profaned the sanctuary, they have done violence to the law.
public_domain_references.kjv: Her prophets [are] light [and] treacherous persons: her priests have polluted the sanctuary, they have done violence to the law.
public_domain_references.brenton: Her prophets are light [and] scornful men: her priests profane the holy things, and sinfully transgress the law.

pob.text: Yahweh is righteous in her midst; he does no injustice[a]. Morning by morning he brings his justice to light; it does not fail. But the unjust knows no shame.

spob.text: Yahweh is righteous in the midst of Jerusalem. He does nothing unjust. Every morning he brings his justice[a] into the light; it never fails to appear. But unjust people have no sense of shame.

public_domain_references.bsb: The LORD within her is righteous; He does no wrong. He applies His justice morning by morning; He does not fail at dawn, yet the unjust know no shame.
public_domain_references.web: Yahweh, within her, is righteous. He will do no wrong. Every morning he brings his justice to light. He doesn’t fail, but the unjust know no shame.
public_domain_references.asv: Jehovah in the midst of her is righteous; he will not do iniquity; every morning doth he bring his justice to light, he faileth not; but the unjust knoweth no shame.
public_domain_references.kjv: The just LORD [is] in the midst thereof; he will not do iniquity: every morning doth he bring his judgment to light, he faileth not; but the unjust knoweth no shame.
public_domain_references.brenton: But the just Lord is in the midst of her, and he will never do an unjust thing: morning by morning he will bring out his judgment to the light, and it is not hidden, and he knows not injustice by extortion, nor injustice in strife.

pob.text: I have cut off nations[a]; their corner towers are laid waste. I have made their streets desolate, with no one passing through. Their cities are devastated, without a man[c][b], with no inhabitant.

spob.text: I have cut off nations. Their corner towers[a] lie in ruins. I have left their streets empty, with no one passing through. Their cities are devastated. Not a man remains; no one lives there.[b]

public_domain_references.bsb: “I have cut off the nations; their corner towers are destroyed. I have made their streets deserted with no one to pass through. Their cities are laid waste, with no man, no inhabitant.
public_domain_references.web: I have cut off nations. Their battlements are desolate. I have made their streets waste, so that no one passes by. Their cities are destroyed, so that there is no man, so that there is no inhabitant.
public_domain_references.asv: I have cut off nations; their battlements are desolate; I have made their streets waste, so that none passeth by; their cities are destroyed, so that there is no man, so that there is no inhabitant.
public_domain_references.kjv: I have cut off the nations: their towers are desolate; I made their streets waste, that none passeth by: their cities are destroyed, so that there is no man, that there is none inhabitant.
public_domain_references.brenton: I have brought down the proud with destruction; their corners are destroyed: I will make their ways completely waste, so that none shall go through: their cities are come to an end, by reason of no man living or dwelling [in them].

pob.text: I said[a], ‘Surely you will fear me; you will accept correction. Then her dwelling would not be cut off, according to all that I had appointed against her.’ But instead, they rose early[b]; they corrupted all their deeds.

spob.text: I said, “Surely you will fear me and accept correction. Then her dwelling would not be cut off, in keeping with everything I had appointed against her.”[a] But instead, they rose early, eagerly corrupting everything they did.

public_domain_references.bsb: I said, ‘Surely you will fear Me and accept correction.’ Then her dwelling place would not be cut off despite all for which I punished her. But they rose early to corrupt all their deeds.
public_domain_references.web: I said, “Just fear me. Receive correction,” so that her dwelling won’t be cut off, according to all that I have appointed concerning her. But they rose early and corrupted all their doings.
public_domain_references.asv: I said, Only fear thou me; receive correction; so her dwelling shall not be cut off, [according to] all that I have appointed concerning her: but they rose early and corrupted all their doings.
public_domain_references.kjv: I said, Surely thou wilt fear me, thou wilt receive instruction; so their dwelling should not be cut off, howsoever I punished them: but they rose early, [and] corrupted all their doings.
public_domain_references.brenton: I said, But do ye fear me, and receive instruction, and ye shall not be cut off from the face of the land [for] all the vengeance I have brought upon her: prepare thou, rise early: all their produce is spoilt.

pob.text: Therefore wait for me[a], declares Yahweh, for the day when I rise up for plunder; for my judgment is to gather nations, to assemble kingdoms, to pour out on them my indignation, all my burning anger[c][b]; for in the fire of my jealousy all the earth will be consumed.

spob.text: “So wait for me,” declares Yahweh, “until the day I rise to give testimony.[a] My judgment is this: I will gather the nations and assemble the kingdoms. I will pour out my indignation on them—all my burning anger. The fire of my jealousy[b] will consume the whole earth.”

public_domain_references.bsb: Therefore wait for Me,” declares the LORD, “until the day I rise to testify. For My decision is to gather nations, to assemble kingdoms, to pour out upon them My indignation— all My burning anger. For all the earth will be consumed by the fire of My jealousy.
public_domain_references.web: “Therefore wait for me”, says Yahweh, “until the day that I rise up to the prey, for my determination is to gather the nations, that I may assemble the kingdoms to pour on them my indignation, even all my fierce anger, for all the earth will be devoured with the fire of my jealousy.
public_domain_references.asv: Therefore wait ye for me, saith Jehovah, until the day that I rise up to the prey; for my determination is to gather the nations, that I may assemble the kingdoms, to pour upon them mine indignation, even all my fierce anger; for all the earth shall be devoured with the fire of my jealousy.
public_domain_references.kjv: ¶ Therefore wait ye upon me, saith the LORD, until the day that I rise up to the prey: for my determination [is] to gather the nations, that I may assemble the kingdoms, to pour upon them mine indignation, [even] all my fierce anger: for all the earth shall be devoured with the fire of my jealousy.
public_domain_references.brenton: Therefore wait upon me, saith the Lord, until the day when I rise up for a witness: because my judgment [shall be] on the gatherings of the nations, to draw to me kings, to pour out upon them all [my] fierce anger: for the whole earth shall be consumed with the fire of my jealousy.

pob.text: For then I will change the speech of the peoples to a pure speech[c][b][a], so that all of them may call on the name of Yahweh and serve him with one accord.

spob.text: Then I will change the peoples’ speech and make it pure,[a] so that they may all call on the name of Yahweh and serve him shoulder to shoulder.

public_domain_references.bsb: For then I will restore pure lips to the peoples, that all may call upon the name of the LORD and serve Him shoulder to shoulder.
public_domain_references.web: For then I will purify the lips of the peoples, that they may all call on Yahweh’s name, to serve him shoulder to shoulder.
public_domain_references.asv: For then will I turn to the peoples of a pure language, that they may all call upon the name of Jehovah, to serve him with one consent.
public_domain_references.kjv: For then will I turn to the people a pure language, that they may all call upon the name of the LORD, to serve him with one consent.
public_domain_references.brenton: For then will I turn to the peoples a tongue for her generation, that all may call on the name of the Lord, to serve him under one yoke.

pob.text: From beyond the rivers of Cush, my worshipers, the daughter of my dispersed ones, will bring my offering.

spob.text: From beyond the rivers of Cush,[a] my worshipers[b]—the daughter of my scattered people[c]—will bring my offering.

public_domain_references.bsb: From beyond the rivers of Cush My worshipers, My scattered people, will bring Me an offering.
public_domain_references.web: From beyond the rivers of Cush, my worshipers, even the daughter of my dispersed people, will bring my offering.
public_domain_references.asv: From beyond the rivers of Ethiopia my suppliants, even the daughter of my dispersed, shall bring mine offering.
public_domain_references.kjv: From beyond the rivers of Ethiopia my suppliants, [even] the daughter of my dispersed, shall bring mine offering.
public_domain_references.brenton: From the boundaries of the rivers of Ethiopia will I receive my dispersed ones; they shall offer sacrifices to me.

pob.text: On that day you will not be put to shame because of all your deeds by which you rebelled against me[a], for then I will remove from your midst those who exult in your pride[b], and you will no longer be haughty on my holy mountain.

spob.text: On that day, you will no longer be put to shame because of all the rebellious things you did against me.[a] Then I will remove from among you those who celebrate with arrogant pride.[b] You will never again act proudly on my holy mountain.

public_domain_references.bsb: On that day you will not be put to shame for any of the deeds by which you have transgressed against Me. For then I will remove from among you those who rejoice in their pride, and you will never again be haughty on My holy mountain.
public_domain_references.web: In that day you will not be disappointed for all your doings in which you have transgressed against me; for then I will take away out from among you your proudly exulting ones, and you will no more be arrogant in my holy mountain.
public_domain_references.asv: In that day shalt thou not be put to shame for all thy doings, wherein thou hast transgressed against me; for then I will take away out of the midst of thee thy proudly exulting ones, and thou shalt no more be haughty in my holy mountain.
public_domain_references.kjv: In that day shalt thou not be ashamed for all thy doings, wherein thou hast transgressed against me: for then I will take away out of the midst of thee them that rejoice in thy pride, and thou shalt no more be haughty because of my holy mountain.
public_domain_references.brenton: In that day thou shalt not be ashamed of all thy practices, wherein thou hast transgressed against me: for then will I take away from thee thy disdainful pride, and thou shalt no more magnify thyself upon my holy mountain.

pob.text: But I will leave in your midst a people humble and lowly[a], and they will take refuge in the name of Yahweh.

spob.text: But I will leave among you a people who are humble and lowly.[a] They will seek refuge in the name of Yahweh.

public_domain_references.bsb: But I will leave within you a meek and humble people, and they will trust in the name of the LORD.
public_domain_references.web: But I will leave among you an afflicted and poor people, and they will take refuge in Yahweh’s name.
public_domain_references.asv: But I will leave in the midst of thee an afflicted and poor people, and they shall take refuge in the name of Jehovah.
public_domain_references.kjv: I will also leave in the midst of thee an afflicted and poor people, and they shall trust in the name of the LORD.
public_domain_references.brenton: And I will leave in thee a meek and lowly people;

pob.text: The remnant of Israel will do no wrong and speak no lies[a], and no deceitful tongue will be found in their mouth; for they will graze and lie down[b], with no one to make them afraid.

spob.text: The remnant of Israel will do no wrong or tell lies. They will not speak deceitfully. They will be like a flock that grazes and lies down, with no one to make them afraid.

public_domain_references.bsb: The remnant of Israel will no longer do wrong or speak lies, nor will a deceitful tongue be found in their mouths. But they will feed and lie down, with no one to make them tremble.”
public_domain_references.web: The remnant of Israel will not do iniquity nor speak lies, neither will a deceitful tongue be found in their mouth, for they will feed and lie down, and no one will make them afraid.”
public_domain_references.asv: The remnant of Israel shall not do iniquity, nor speak lies; neither shall a deceitful tongue be found in their mouth; for they shall feed and lie down, and none shall make them afraid.
public_domain_references.kjv: The remnant of Israel shall not do iniquity, nor speak lies; neither shall a deceitful tongue be found in their mouth: for they shall feed and lie down, and none shall make [them] afraid.
public_domain_references.brenton: and the remnant of Israel shall fear the name of the Lord, and shall do no iniquity, neither shall they speak vanity; neither shall a deceitful tongue be found in their mouth: for they shall feed, and lie down, and there shall be none to terrify them.

pob.text: Sing for joy[a], daughter Zion; shout aloud, Israel! Rejoice and exult with all your heart, daughter Jerusalem!

spob.text: Zion[a], sing for joy! Israel, shout aloud! Jerusalem, be glad and celebrate with all your heart!

public_domain_references.bsb: Sing for joy, O Daughter of Zion; shout aloud, O Israel! Be glad and rejoice with all your heart, O Daughter of Jerusalem!
public_domain_references.web: Sing, daughter of Zion! Shout, Israel! Be glad and rejoice with all your heart, daughter of Jerusalem.
public_domain_references.asv: Sing, O daughter of Zion; shout, O Israel; be glad and rejoice with all the heart, O daughter of Jerusalem.
public_domain_references.kjv: ¶ Sing, O daughter of Zion; shout, O Israel; be glad and rejoice with all the heart, O daughter of Jerusalem.
public_domain_references.brenton: Rejoice, O daughter of Sion; cry aloud, O daughter of Jerusalem; rejoice and delight thyself with all thine heart, O daughter of Jerusalem.

pob.text: Yahweh has taken away your judgments[a]; he has turned away your enemy. The King of Israel, Yahweh, is in your midst[b]; you will fear evil no more.

spob.text: Yahweh has removed the judgments against you[a] and driven your enemy away. Yahweh, the King of Israel, is among you. You will no longer fear evil.[b]

public_domain_references.bsb: The LORD has taken away your punishment; He has turned back your enemy. Israel’s King, the LORD, is among you; no longer will you fear any harm.
public_domain_references.web: Yahweh has taken away your judgments. He has thrown out your enemy. The King of Israel, Yahweh, is among you. You will not be afraid of evil any more.
public_domain_references.asv: Jehovah hath taken away thy judgments, he hath cast out thine enemy: the King of Israel, even Jehovah, is in the midst of thee; thou shalt not fear evil any more.
public_domain_references.kjv: The LORD hath taken away thy judgments, he hath cast out thine enemy: the king of Israel, [even] the LORD, [is] in the midst of thee: thou shalt not see evil any more.
public_domain_references.brenton: The Lord has taken away thine iniquities, he has ransomed thee from the hand of thine enemies: the Lord, the King of Israel, is in the midst of thee: thou shalt not see evil any more.

pob.text: On that day it will be said to Jerusalem[a], “Do not fear”; to Zion, “Do not let your hands grow weak.”

spob.text: On that day, it will be said to Jerusalem, “Do not be afraid.” To Zion, “Do not let your hands grow weak.”

public_domain_references.bsb: On that day they will say to Jerusalem: “Do not fear, O Zion; do not let your hands fall limp.
public_domain_references.web: In that day, it will be said to Jerusalem, “Don’t be afraid, Zion. Don’t let your hands be weak.”
public_domain_references.asv: In that day it shall be said to Jerusalem, Fear thou not; O Zion, let not thy hands be slack.
public_domain_references.kjv: In that day it shall be said to Jerusalem, Fear thou not: [and to] Zion, Let not thine hands be slack.
public_domain_references.brenton: At that time the Lord shall say to Jerusalem, Be of good courage, Sion; let not thine hands be slack.

pob.text: Yahweh your God is in your midst[a], a mighty one who saves; he will rejoice over you with gladness; he will be quiet in his love; he will exult over you with singing.

spob.text: Yahweh your God is among you. He is mighty and saves. He will rejoice over you with gladness. In his love, he will be quiet.[a] He will celebrate over you with singing.

public_domain_references.bsb: The LORD your God is among you; He is mighty to save. He will rejoice over you with gladness; He will quiet you with His love; He will rejoice over you with singing.”
public_domain_references.web: Yahweh, your God, is among you, a mighty one who will save. He will rejoice over you with joy. He will calm you in his love. He will rejoice over you with singing.
public_domain_references.asv: Jehovah thy God is in the midst of thee, a mighty one who will save; he will rejoice over thee with joy; he will rest in his love; he will joy over thee with singing.
public_domain_references.kjv: The LORD thy God in the midst of thee [is] mighty; he will save, he will rejoice over thee with joy; he will rest in his love, he will joy over thee with singing.
public_domain_references.brenton: The Lord thy God is in thee; the Mighty One shall save thee: he shall bring joy upon thee, and shall refresh thee with his love; and he shall rejoice over thee with delight as in a day of feasting.

pob.text: I have gathered those grieving over the appointed festival from you[a]; they were a reproach upon her[c][b], a burden.

spob.text: I have gathered[a] from you those who grieve over the appointed festival.[b] They were a disgrace upon her[c] and a burden.

public_domain_references.bsb: “I will gather those among you who grieve over the appointed feasts, so that you will no longer suffer reproach.
public_domain_references.web: I will remove those who grieve about the appointed feasts from you. They are a burden and a reproach to you.
public_domain_references.asv: I will gather them that sorrow for the solemn assembly, who were of thee; [to whom] the burden upon her was a reproach.
public_domain_references.kjv: I will gather [them that are] sorrowful for the solemn assembly, [who] are of thee, [to whom] the reproach of it [was] a burden.
public_domain_references.brenton: And I will gather thine afflicted ones. Alas! who has taken up a reproach against her?

pob.text: Behold[a], at that time I will deal with all your oppressors, and I will save the lame and gather the outcast[d][c][b], and I will make them a praise and a name in every land where they were put to shame.

spob.text: Behold, at that time I will act against all who oppress you. I will save those who are lame and gather those who were driven away. I will make them praised and renowned in every land where they were put to shame.[a]

public_domain_references.bsb: Behold, at that time, I will deal with all who afflict you. I will save the lame and gather the scattered; and I will appoint praise and fame for the disgraced throughout the earth.
public_domain_references.web: Behold, at that time I will deal with all those who afflict you; and I will save those who are lame and gather those who were driven away. I will give them praise and honor, whose shame has been in all the earth.
public_domain_references.asv: Behold, at that time I will deal with all them that afflict thee; and I will save that which is lame, and gather that which was driven away; and I will make them a praise and a name, whose shame hath been in all the earth.
public_domain_references.kjv: Behold, at that time I will undo all that afflict thee: and I will save her that halteth, and gather her that was driven out; and I will get them praise and fame in every land where they have been put to shame.
public_domain_references.brenton: Behold, I [will] work in thee for thy sake at that time, saith the Lord: and I will save her that was oppressed, and receive her that was rejected; and I will make them a praise, and honoured in all the earth.

pob.text: At that time I will bring you in[a], and at that time I will gather you; for I will make you a name and a praise among all the peoples of the earth, when I restore your fortunes before your eyes, says Yahweh.

spob.text: At that time I will bring you in and gather you together. I will make you renowned and praised among all the peoples of the earth when I restore your fortunes[a] before your own eyes, says Yahweh.

public_domain_references.bsb: At that time I will bring you in; yes, at that time I will gather you. For I will give you fame and praise among all the peoples of the earth when I restore your captives before your very eyes,” says the LORD.
public_domain_references.web: At that time I will bring you in, and at that time I will gather you; for I will give you honor and praise among all the peoples of the earth when I restore your fortunes before your eyes, says Yahweh.
public_domain_references.asv: At that time will I bring you in, and at that time will I gather you; for I will make you a name and a praise among all the peoples of the earth, when I bring back your captivity before your eyes, saith Jehovah.
public_domain_references.kjv: At that time will I bring you [again], even in the time that I gather you: for I will make you a name and a praise among all people of the earth, when I turn back your captivity before your eyes, saith the LORD.
public_domain_references.brenton: And [their enemies] shall be ashamed at that time, when I shall deal well with you, and at the time when I shall receive you: for I will make you honoured and a praise among all the nations of the earth, when I turn back your captivity before you, saith the Lord.
